text:
No option can be put forward yet: the analysis could not test your requirement that monthly churn stays **below 4%**.

- The comparison itself held up under the changes tested, but it rests largely on Olumi estimates, including Pro subscriber count, conversions, churn and other-plan MRR—not recorded measurements.
- The model is structurally most sensitive to **Pro subscriber count**; that is an Olumi estimate. It also treats the MRR goal as “higher is better”, an assumption rather than a stated objective direction.
- The £20k/month target was not scored because the model lacks a baseline MRR in the same frame, and the 12‑month horizon is not represented.

To make the churn condition testable, specify which measured model component the **<4% monthly** limit applies to.
